propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors and replication_errors) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, causing state transitions to fire silently with no notifications sent to operators.

The repo convention established by 11 of 13 existing alarms is to wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to the shared aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; these two alarms are the only exceptions and violate the documented pattern.

A regression guard test was added to parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block in infra/terraform/ and fail on any missing alarm_actions, with mandatory anti-vacuity assertion (>= 13 alarms) to prevent vacuous passes.
The fix was merged to main but remained un-applied in production; live describe-alarms continued to show empty AlarmActions/OKActions until terraform apply was executed by an operator.

After applying the change, both alarms now route state transitions to the confirmed email subscription on the SNS topic, and forced end-to-end notification testing verified delivery to the configured subscriber.
